newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wins in S. Korean grassfed tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wins in S. Korean grassfed tender.

text.p: Australia won the majority of the grassfed components in South Korea's fourth beef tender for the 1997 quota year, the Australian Meat and Livestock Corp said in a statement on Wednesday.

Australian exporters were awarded 97.2 percent, or 3,510 tonnes, in the Livestock Products Marketing Organisation's tender for 3,610 tonnes of grassfed bone-in quarter beef, it said. New Zealand secured the remaining 2.8 percent, or 100 tonnes, it said.

Australia also secured the majority of the grassfed fullset order, securing 86.7 percent, or 468 tonnes, in the full tender for 540 tonnes, it said. New Zealand took 13.3 percent, or 72 tonnes, it said.
The U.S. won the full order for 2,933 tonnes of grainfed beef cuts, it said.
Australia competed strongly for the tender, AMLC said. New Zealand did not compete as strongly as in the last tender and had fewer cattle available, it said.
As a result of the tender, Australia's market share in LPMO tenders in the 1997 quota year so far had improved to 41.9 percent from 28.4 percent in the same period last year, it said.
LPMO had now purchased 36 percent of its minimum quota of 83,500 tonnes (boneless equivalent) for the 1997 quota year, it said.
